tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description:
Every MT5 account connected to this Pipwire workspace: id, name, broker server, login, access
(read or trade), connection status, balance, equity and currency. Use the ids with the other tools.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description:
Live summary of one account from its terminal: balance, equity, profit, margin, free margin,
margin level, leverage and currency.

tools.name: get_positions
tools.description:
Open positions on an account (optionally one symbol): side, volume, open price, current price,
stop loss, take profit, swap and floating profit.

tools.name: get_deal_history
tools.description:
Closed deals (fills) in a UTC time window; default the last 7 days. With position_id, only that
position's deals (default window 90 days). Use this for realised P/L.

tools.name: get_order_history
tools.description: Orders that finished in a UTC time window (filled, rejected, canceled); default the last 7 days.

tools.name: get_open_orders
tools.description:
Pending orders still waiting at the broker (buy/sell limit, stop and stop-limit): price, stops,
expiry and the client's id.

tools.name: search_symbols
tools.description: The broker's symbol names matching a pattern (MT5 wildcards, e.g. "*XAU*" or "EUR*").

tools.name: get_symbol
tools.description:
Contract details for one symbol: digits, contract size, volume limits and step, stop level,
tick value, trading mode, swaps.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Latest bid and ask for a symbol, from the account's own terminal, with its UTC time.

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: OHLC candles from the account's terminal, times in UTC. timeframe is one of: 1m, 2m, 3m, 4m, 5m, 6m, 10m, 12m, 15m, 20m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 3h, 4h, 6h, 8h, 12h, 1d, 1w, 1mn. Newest `limit` bars (max 1000), or bars from `start`, or every bar between `start` and `end`.

tools.name: get_account_events
tools.description:
What happened to an account's connection, newest first: connected, disconnected, error,
restarted, paused, resumed, and orders placed through the API.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description:
Place a market order (fills now) or a pending limit, stop or stop-limit order. Volume is in lots.
price is the pending order's price; stop_limit_price is the limit placed once a stop_limit's price is
hit; expires_at (UTC, ISO 8601) cancels a pending order at that time. client_id (letters, digits,
-

tools.name: close_position
tools.description:
Close an open position at market, or only `volume` lots of it (a partial close). Get ids from
get_positions. Needs a Trade key with MCP trading on. Real money: only when the user asked.

tools.name: modify_position
tools.description:
Set an open position's stop loss and/or take profit. Leave one out to keep it; 0 removes it.
Needs a Trade key with MCP trading on.

tools.name: modify_order
tools.description:
Change a pending order's price, stop-limit price, stop loss, take profit or expiry (UTC, ISO 8601).
Leave a field out to keep it; 0 removes a stop loss or take profit. Get ids from get_open_orders.
Needs a Trade key with MCP trading on.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel a pending order. Get ids from get_open_orders. Needs a Trade key with MCP trading on.
